changelog: Show series title cards in search, index alphabetized TV and anime folders, and tolerate one title typo. Batch media server searches, add an optional per-user search limit, and link to GitHub issue reporting from Search. Add an in-app setup guide and collapsible Setup Media panels.
description: Search private media servers, import links, and add movies, shows, or anime to Jellyfin as streams or local files.
name: Media Source Bridge
overview: Search private media sources and add streams or download media to Jellyfin libraries.
